reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 1001 for 3003 receivers. Lower bound is an independent set of size 1001 (check passed); upper bound is a linear code M = I + A over F_5 of length 1001 (code_fits, factorization and decoding checks all passed). Only 1 code was tried. Versus baselines: cpsat_alpha found 1001 but did not prove it in 123.3 s; cpsat_cover timed out; frac_cover gave only 3003; f2_minrank_sat reached lower 1000 in 1.2 s. kushagra_agent also proved 1001 (field 5) in 4.38 s, faster than our wall time of 28.883 s; our compute_s of 3.971 s is comparable, but LLM time (24.912 s over 2 calls) dominates, so we lose on wall-clock time to that baseline. Nothing suspicious; own_rank is unavailable since N > 2500.
